hotel.name: Glimmora
hotel.description: A luxury boutique hotel offering exceptional hospitality and personalized service.

hours.late_check_out: Available upon request (additional charges may apply)

cancellation.description: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before check-in. Cancellations within 48 hours will be charged the first night's rate.

pets.description: Pets under 30 lbs are welcome with a $50/night fee. Service animals are always welcome at no additional charge.

policies.smoking: Non-smoking property. Designated outdoor smoking areas available.
policies.age_requirement: Guests must be 21 years or older to check in.
policies.id_requirement: Valid government-issued photo ID required at check-in.

room_types.name: Suite
room_types.description: Luxury suite with separate living area

room_types.name: Pacific Suite
room_types.description: Premium oceanview suite with private balcony

ai_assistant.name: Aria
ai_assistant.greeting: Hello! I'm Aria, your personal assistant at {hotel_name}. How can I help you today?
ai_assistant.fallback_message: I apologize, but I'm not able to help with that request. Please contact our front desk at {phone_main} for assistance.
ai_assistant.escalation_message: I'd be happy to connect you with our team. Please contact us at {phone_main} or email {email_support} for immediate assistance.

support.human_handoff_message: For immediate assistance, please contact our 24/7 front desk at {phone_main}. You can also email {email_support} and we'll respond within 1 hour during business hours.
support.emergency_message: For emergencies, please call {phone_emergency} or dial 911.
support.feedback_message: We value your feedback! Please email {email_feedback} or speak with our front desk.
